2024-03-17 14:00:00: Adjuster notes hidden damage to rear sensors discovered during detailed inspection. Additional repair work required for sensor calibration and replacement.

2024-03-20 16:00:00: Preliminary approval: 7,800 ILS total repair cost (includes bumper replacement, sensor repair, paint work, and labor).

================================================================================

================================================================================

2024-03-21 09:30:00: Special note logged by senior adjuster: Deductible temporarily reduced to 850 ILS for this claim only. Standard deductible is 1,500 ILS. This override is applied as a loyalty retention benefit because the policy holder has long-term continuous coverage (8 years) with no at-fault accidents. The override is explicitly limited to this single claim only and is not applied to future claims or the policy as a whole.

2024-03-21 09:35:00: Deductible override approved by claims manager. System updated: CLM-2024-0193 deductible set to 850 ILS (override code: LOYALTY-RETENTION-2024).

================================================================================

================================================================================

2024-03-25 10:00:00: Policyholder requests rental car coverage during repair period.

2024-03-26 11:00:00: Rental car coverage approved for 5 days with a daily limit of 200 ILS per day for a compact class vehicle. Maximum coverage: 1,000 ILS (5 days × 200 ILS/day).

2024-03-26 11:15:00: Rental car provider contacted: "CarRent Tel Aviv". Vehicle assigned: Compact class, pickup scheduled for repair start date.

================================================================================
P5 – Final Invoice, Metadata Inconsistency, Payout, and Closure
================================================================================

2024-04-02 15:00:00: Final invoice uploaded by garage: 7,650 ILS.

Invoice number in document header: INV-7645.

2024-04-02 15:05:00: System metadata shows invoice ID as INV-7645A (note the 'A' suffix). System auto-normalizes this inconsistency without financial impact. Both references point to the same invoice document.

2024-04-02 15:30:00: Final payout calculation:
  - Repair invoice: 7,650 ILS
  - Reduced deductible: 850 ILS
  - Total payout: 6,800 ILS (7,650 - 850)

2024-04-04 17:00:00: Claim closed. Total payout: 6,800 ILS transferred to policy holder account. Claim status: CLOSED. Closure reason: Repairs completed, payment processed.

Claim status: CLOSED. Closure reason: Repairs completed, payment processed.
